    · intros; exact Nat.zero_le _
    · intro n hk
      apply Nat.succ_le_of_lt
      calc
        k ≤ f (f (n - 1)) := h_ind _ (h_ind (n - 1) (le_tsub_of_add_le_right hk))
        _ < f n := tsub_add_cancel_of_le (le_trans (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le _)) hk) ▸ h _
  /-
    f : Nat → Nat
    h : ∀ (n : Nat), LT.lt (f (f n)) (f (HAdd.hAdd n 1))
    h' : ∀ (k n : Nat), LE.le k n → LE.le k (f n)
    ⊢ ∀ (n : Nat), Eq (f n) n
  -/

    h : ∀ (n : Nat), LT.lt (f (f n)) (f (HAdd.hAdd n 1))
    h' : ∀ (k n : Nat), LE.le k n → LE.le k (f n)
    hf : ∀ (n : Nat), LE.le n (f n)

  -/

--src: Mathlib.Data.PNat.Find
@[simp]
theorem find_lt_iff (n : ℕ+) : PNat.find h < n ↔ ∃ m < n, p m :=
  ⟨fun h2 => ⟨PNat.find h, h2, PNat.find_spec h⟩, fun ⟨_, hmn, hm⟩ =>
    (PNat.find_min' h hm).trans_lt hmn⟩

theorem recOn_one {p} (p1 hp) : @PNat.recOn 1 p p1 hp = p1 :=
  rfl

--src: Mathlib.Data.PNat.Basic
/-- If `n : ℕ+` is different from `1`, then it is the successor of some `k : ℕ+`. -/
theorem exists_eq_succ_of_ne_one : ∀ {n : ℕ+} (_ : n ≠ 1), ∃ k : ℕ+, n = k + 1
  | ⟨1, _⟩, h₁ => False.elim <| h₁ rfl
  | ⟨n + 2, _⟩, _ => ⟨⟨n + 1, by simp⟩, rfl⟩

--src: Mathlib.Data.PNat.Find
theorem find_comp_succ (h : ∃ n, p n) (h₂ : ∃ n, p (n + 1)) (h1 : ¬p 1) :
    PNat.find h = PNat.find h₂ + 1 := by
  refine (find_eq_iff _).2 ⟨PNat.find_spec h₂, fun n => PNat.recOn n ?_ ?_⟩
  · simp [h1]
  intro m _ hm
  simp only [add_lt_add_iff_right, lt_find_iff] at hm
  exact hm _ le_rfl
